verdict.rationale: Next.js documents itself as a React framework with React components, including async server components and components that ship no client JavaScript, plus composable UI layouts. That establishes a component model it composes into UIs. However, nothing in the pack documents components managing their own local state or client-side reactivity. Missing for 10: documented local/client component state, explicit guidance on composing stateful components into complex UIs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build encapsulated components that manage their own local state and compose them into complex UIs

citations.quote: Make your React component async and await your data.
Add components without sending additional client-side JavaScript.
support for more advanced routing patterns and UI layouts
Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications.
